blocks.text: The target projects in DSPM refer to the GCP projects that DSPM must monitor. You can add new target projects to the existing onboarded GCP account. DSPM monitors and scans the data stores within the onboarded projects to identify sensitive data, misconfigurations, and vulnerabilities.
You must be assigned either an Administrator role or a custom role with the Configure Monitoring Scope permission in the Zscaler Admin Console.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Configuration > Cloud Accounts.
The Cloud Accounts page with the Overview tab appears.
On the Overview tab, select the onboarded account for which you want to add new projects.
Click Manage and select Add Target Projects from the drop-down menu.
The Add Target Projects window appears.
In the Add Target Projects window, enter the following information:
Project ID: Enter the subscription ID.
Project Name (Optional): Enter the subscription name.
Business Unit: Select a business unit for the subscription.
Click + Add Project to add more subscriptions.
On the Roles and Templates tab, click GCP Onboarding to download and deploy the template.
